scope.note: Snapshot of public categories, not a census of every ArkApi plugin. Framework listing included and classified separately.
scope.coverage_definition: All records returned by every advertised page of included categories at retrieval; not all historical/unlisted/private plugins or full behavior of each product.
scope.version_notice: listed_version is catalog metadata observed, not a binary or independently validated release; metadata can change.

method.http_client: stdlib urllib; ordinary public HTML with browser user-agent; no login
method.direct_html_access_without_user_agent: 403 on bare host; www public HTML returned 200 using ordinary browser user-agent
method.pagination: Every advertised page of three ASE plugin categories; resource_id deduplication.
method.contracts: Public product descriptions only; own Spanish capability summaries, command token candidates, factual metadata and project dependency assessments. No vendor configs, implementation, DLL or paid package copied.
method.categories_ignore_sidebar: Parsed only primary structItem resource cards, never shared ASA ads/top/trending/sidebar items.

planned_primitives.deliverable: Namespace/proveedor/sujeto de cuenta verificados, roster autoritativo y sesión invalidable; confirmar Steam/Epic sin inferirlo del ID nativo opaco.
Cola residente con datos copiados, cancelación por generación/sesión y deadlines; callbacks de worker nunca ejecutan UE.
Acciones de inventario con cantidad/clase/estado comprobables y resultados parciales o inciertos explícitos.
Integrar almacenes propios de permisos y wallets con identidad verificada y administración local auditada.
Consultas autoritativas de actores, propiedad y roles de tribu con reconciliación y save identity.
Hooks de decisión comprobados, transporte de cluster con deduplicación, protocolo visual y contratos externos por módulo.

acceptance_policy.equivalence_unit: individual observed scenario for pinned reference product/version/config
acceptance_policy.template: trigger; command or UI action; initial state; recipient/target; visible output; mutation; costs/limits/cooldown; persistence; failure/lifecycle; recordings; Steam/Epic matrix

selected_public_contracts.scope: contrato público de jugador y persistencia; referencia 3.05
observable_requirements: Saldo propio, catálogo paginado y búsqueda; compra y venta cambian inventario y moneda con cantidades verificadas.
Un kit comprado se reclama mediante acción separada; preservar máximos, costes y cooldowns documentados para la configuración seleccionada.
Referencia incluye recompensas por tiempo y dependencia Permissions; documenta SteamID para operaciones administrativas.
selected_public_contracts.obelisk_gap: oShopKits actual es catálogo informativo; no compra, vende, cobra ni entrega. Ledger y recibos privados offline no prueban paridad de juego.

selected_public_contracts.scope: administración de grupos y permisos; referencia 2.1

current_obelisk_context: Current private permission/wallet/receipt and runtime foundations are evidence at their own test levels; this snapshot assigns no reference product a real-client gameplay parity acceptance.

command_syntax.required: Exact verbs, aliases, case, delimiters, arguments, configurable command names, validation and error output for pinned profile.

default_limits.required: Documented default quotas, quantities, price/cost, range, interval, cooldown, persistence and administrator overrides; never invent undocumented values.

persistence.required: Account vs character vs tribe scope; relogin, restart, save identity, transfer, merge, reload and unresolved operation outcomes.

visible_output.required: Private/global/local/tribe recipients, text/format/colors/icons, top-screen notification vs chat, HUD/GUI, timing and replicated gameplay effect.

client_mod_or_gui.required: Check client mod/UI requirement and acceptance separately on Steam and Epic; absence of mod mention is not proof that all features are mod-free.

failure_lifecycle.required: Cancellation on logout/reload/pause/stop, inventory full/partial, no stale-session delivery, callback draining and reconciliation after crash.

steam_epic_gameplay.required: Record matching results with real Steam and Epic clients for every selected scenario.
